title.en: An Act Creating the Barrio of Samariniana, in the Municipality of Brooke’s Point, Province of Palawan
title.orig: An Act Creating the Barrio of Samariniana, in the Municipality of Brooke’s Point, Province of Palawan
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập một Barrio Samariniana tại Đô thị Brooke's Point, Tỉnh Palawan
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งบาริโอ Samariniana ในเทศบาล Brooke's Point จังหวัด Palawan
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk sebuah Barrio Samariniana di Kotamadya Brooke's Point, Provinsi Palawan
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan sebuah Barrio Samariniana di Perbandaran Brooke's Point, Wilayah Palawan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1954/ra_1012_1954.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Such part of the barrio of Tanionbog, municipality of Brooke’s Point, Province of Palawan, as bounded on the North by the Tamlang River, with this boundary following the natural course of the Tamlang River up to the mountain; on the West by mountain divide, with this boundary to follow the mountain divide; on the East by the seashore facing the Sulu Sea; and on the South by the Cabcaben River, with this boundary to follow the Cabcaben River from the seashore to the mountain, is hereby segregated from said barrio and constituted into an independent barrio to be known as Samariniana.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 12, 1954.
